actions: Check the business p95 metric, not only probe status.
analysis: The demo deliberately keeps health probes fast during latency injection, so passing probes are not evidence of low business latency.
cautions: Do not infer business performance from probe success.
excerpt:
env：`DEMO_LATENCY_MS=3000`。`/healthz`、`/readyz` 不注入延迟，避免探针误杀；
业务延迟看 histogram：

```promql
histogram_quantile(0.95,
  sum by (le) (rate(demo_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/work"}[5m])))
```
rollback: Restore DEMO_LATENCY_MS=0 and watch the histogram p95 recover.
title: 探针不注入延迟
